question: Should this protected, large Control UI feature be held for a refreshed full review once source inspection is available?
rationale: The `maintainer` label prevents automated cleanup, and the failed sandbox means no defensible source-level correctness or compatibility verdict can be made.

options.title: Refresh source review
options.body: Re-run review with access to current main, PR head, scoped policies, maintainer notes, and relevant tests before deciding merge readiness.

options.title: Pause the PR
options.body: Keep the PR open but defer review until a browser proof and a functioning source-review environment are available.

recommendation.title: Refresh source review
recommendation.body: Re-run review with access to current main, PR head, scoped policies, maintainer notes, and relevant tests before deciding merge readiness.
